jobs.title: Agent/AI Engineer
jobs.description:
We're partnering with a growing team building an internal AI platform designed to power intelligent, agent-driven workflows across the business. The core platform is already in place, and they're now looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help build and scale the next generation of AI agents on top of it.
This is a hands-on role focused on developing real, production-oriented AI workflows—not just experimentation. You'll work closely with an AI Architect to expand capabilities, improve performance, and bring new use cases to life.

What You'll Do
Build and enhance AI-driven workflows ( "agents”) that can take input, make decisions, and trigger actions across systems
Develop scalable, production-ready solutions on top of an existing internal AI platform

jobs.title: Databricks Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
About MathCo

MathCo® (TheMathCompany) is a global Enterprise AI and Analytics company that partners with leading organizations to solve complex business problems through data, AI, and technology. Our teams combine deep domain expertise, advanced analytics, data engineering, and AI capabilities to help clients accelerate business outcomes and drive measurable impact.
As we continue expanding our Data & AI Platform practice, we are seeking experienced Databricks Solutions Architects to help clients modernize their data ecosystems and unlock the full potential of AI and advanced analytics.

Role Overview

As a Databricks Solutions Architect
, you will serve as a trusted advisor to enterprise clients, helping shape and deliver large-scale data, analytics, AI, and cloud transformation initiatives. You will partner closely with client executives, account leaders, delivery teams, and technology partners to architect innovative solutions that accelerate business value.
The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise in Databricks and modern data platforms with strong client-facing consulting skills and the ability to influence executive stakeholders.
This role sits at the intersection of solution architecture, strategic consulting, technical pre-sales, and business growth.

Key Responsibilities

Serve as a trusted technical advisor to clients on enterprise data, analytics, AI, and cloud transformation strategies.
Lead architecture and solution design initiatives leveraging Databricks and modern cloud data platforms.
Drive technical discovery sessions, architecture workshops, platform assessments, and executive presentations.
Design scalable data, AI, and analytics solutions aligned with clients' strategic objectives and business outcomes.
Partner with sales and account teams to shape, solution, and support strategic opportunities.
Develop modernization roadmaps across data engineering, machine learning, generative AI, governance, and analytics initiatives.
Collaborate with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Cloud Architects, and Delivery Leaders to ensure successful solution implementation.
Build strong relationships with client stakeholders, including CIOs, CDOs, Data & Analytics leaders, and business executives.
Support platform adoption and value realization across enterprise accounts.
Contribute to MathCo's thought leadership through client workshops, solution accelerators, industry events, and innovation initiatives.
Mentor and guide architects, consultants, and engineering teams on Databricks best practices and modern data architecture patterns.
Contribute to capability development within the Databricks, Data Engineering, and AI practices.

Required Qualifications

8+ years of experience in Solutions Architecture, Data Engineering, Cloud Architecture, Technical Consulting, or Customer-Facing Technology Leadership roles.
Hands-on expertise with the Databricks Lakehouse Platform.
Strong experience developing solutions using Python, SQL, Spark, and PySpark.
Deep understanding of modern data platform architecture, including:
Data Engineering
Data Warehousing & Lakehouses
Real-Time & Streaming Architectures
Data Governance & Security
AI/ML Platforms
Generative AI Solutions
Experience architecting enterprise-scale cloud solutions on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
Proven success leading technical strategy and architecture discussions with senior client stakeholders.
Ability to connect technical architecture decisions to business outcomes and ROI.
Strong communication, presentation, and executive stakeholder management skills.
Experience supporting complex enterprise evaluations, migration programs, or platform modernization initiatives.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Information Systems, or a related field.

Preferred Qualifications

Databricks certifications (Data Engineer, Architect, ML Engineer, or related).
Experience with Snowflake, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform, or other modern data ecosystems.
Consulting or professional services experience working with Fortune 500 organizations.
Experience with AI/ML, MLOps, and Generative AI use cases.
Industry expertise in Retail, CPG, Manufacturing, Healthcare, Financial Services, or Technology.
Published thought leadership, conference speaking engagements, or open-source contributions.

Success in this Role

Establish trusted advisor relationships with executive client stakeholders.
Drive successful architecture and solutioning for strategic Databricks-led transformations.
Accelerate client adoption of modern data and AI platforms.
Influence revenue growth through technical leadership and solution excellence.
Build reusable assets, frameworks, and best practices that strengthen MathCo's Data & AI capabilities.
Mentor teams and contribute to the continued growth of MathCo's technology and consulting practices.

Show more

Show less

Mid-Senior level

Employment type

Full-time

Industries

Business Consulting and Services
